message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "mediastinal_mass_morphological_differentiation", "description": "When evaluating a suspected mediastinal mass on chest imaging, prioritize morphological analysis of the lateral view over initial classifier confidence scores to determine anatomical compartment and malignancy risk.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the interpretation of chest radiographs where a mediastinal abnormality is detected or suspected, requiring differentiation between anterior/posterior masses or benign/malignant etiologies.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If a mediastinal mass is identified: (1) Use `chest_xray_classifier` to confirm the presence of the mass; (2) Immediately call `chest_xray_report_generator` specifically on the lateral view to assess anterior vs. posterior location and margin morphology (e.g., lobulated/ill-defined vs. smooth); (3) Base the final differential diagnosis primarily on these morphological findings (e.g., anterior + lobulated suggests thymic carcinoma) rather than relying solely on the classifier's probability scores."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
